name: The Black Shield
summary: At the burned Shady Rest Inn, a black shield clings to the crumbling chimney. Krog at Brackenwall Village waits to see it.

sections.title: A Shield on the Chimney
sections.body: Fire swept through the Shady Rest Inn and left little behind. An iron shield, charred black, is fixed to the crumbling chimney. You can work it free of the brick and bring it to Krog at Brackenwall Village. He will ask whether it counts as evidence from the inn’s remains.

sections.title: What Krog Makes of It
sections.body: Krog grants that humans have odd tastes in decoration. Yet he doubts anyone would hang a plain iron shield over a fireplace. He suspects whoever set the inn ablaze left it there as a warning or a threat.

faq.q: Where is the black shield found?
faq.answer: The black shield is fixed to the chimney of the burned Shady Rest Inn, one of the few remnants of the building.
Bring the shield to Krog at Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Can the shield be taken from the chimney?
faq.answer: Yes. You can work the shield loose from the chimney’s brick.
